anti_goal_violations.evidence: OPEN — three disclosed, fail-closed divergences between the shipped code and the canonical spec, all found by the auditor and all needing an owner ruling BEFORE J-07/J-08 pool real distributions against them: (B2) crossed_midrange (desk_playbook_detect.py:1180-1190) serves only the approach reading; spec §3.7 (docs/playbook-detector-spec.md:334-335) asks for the approach AND whether the prior swing turned at midrange. (B3) the double_top search (:1328-1329) returns the first valid PAIR, which need not be spec §3.8's 'first valid valley break'; deterministic and capped at 1 per detector per symbol-session. (B4) range_trade's trigger anchors only on the arming-completing touch (:1131-1134) where spec §3.7 anchors on any zone touch; it can only miss signals, never invent one (10 range_trade signals still fired across the 101-member real universe). Correctly left unfixed rather than improvised.
